_comment: BOTH gates trip at once: run 0 errored before grading (structurally unusable, rc 2) and run 1 has a red deterministic assertion (rc 1). The exit code must be the HIGHEST, 2 -- a deterministic verdict drawn from a suite that did not complete is not a trustworthy statement about the plugin, and reporting rc 1 here sends the reader to fix an assertion instead of the run. Before the max() fix the deterministic check ran last and its rc=1 overwrote the structural rc=2, contradicting the documented rule.
